summary: Routine ABS securitization: EFCAR, LLC, acting as depositor, reported that on September 28, 2026 it transferred sub-prime auto loan receivables to Exeter Select Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-2, which in turn conveyed them to Exeter Select Holding Trust 2026-2 in exchange for 100% of its beneficial interests, pledged to Citibank as indenture trustee. The Trust issued eight classes of notes across a roughly $505M capital structure, including Class A-1 through A-3, Class B through E, and Class N, under agreements dated August 31, 2026.
